notes.title: Fixed bugs such as flying enemies getting stuck in walls and added mouse support
notes.notes:
Fixed the issue where flying enemies might get stuck in walls and stop moving.

The sawtooth flying insects will shoot darts to the left and right.

The tracking speed of bats and wasps has been increased.

Now you can use the mouse to attack and switch items.

notes.title: Add a weapon: Chain Axe
notes.notes:
[p]The game already has melee weapons (sword) and ranged weapons (spear), but it was missing a mid-range weapon. So I added: [b]the chain-axe[/b].[/p][p]This is a large mid-range weapon that deals damage both on the initial attack and during its return spin. It usually hits twice, making it perfect for attacking [b]ceiling spiders[/b] in caves.[/p][p]Why did I make a chain-axe instead of something simpler like a boomerang? Mainly because I really love the early [b]frame-by-frame animation[/b] style of the [i]Fire Emblem[/i] series. Every attack felt so impactful, and I thought the [b]chain-lance[/b] and [b]chain-axe[/b] looked incredibly cool. I wanted to recreate that feeling in this game. Hope you all like it![/p][p]Additionally, I really want the game to have meaningful late-game content, so players can enjoy it for a long time. I'm planning to add a [b]difficulty system[/b] and a [b]card system[/b]. The approach will be similar to [i]Back 4 Blood[/i]:[/p][list][*][p]Earn gold during the early/mid-game to buy cards.[/p][/*][*][p]Build specialized decks for the late game.[/p][/*][*][p]Every weapon and item can enable unique, extreme playstyles.[/p][/*][*][p]Players can bring cards into each run, and weapons/items of varying rarities will also drop randomly.[/p][/*][*][p]It's a mix of fixed progression and randomness.[/p][/*][*][p]Enemies will scale and become stronger on higher difficulties, but you'll earn more gold too.[/p][/*][/list][p]On another note... game sales have been really poor. So far, it's only made about [b]$200 USD[/b]. After subtracting the [b]$100 store fee[/b], it hasn't even covered the electricity bill. If one day you stop seeing updates... I might have starved. I'm not hoping to get rich—just to survive. If anyone's interested, you could try buying it. If you don't like it, just refund it. If you already bought it and enjoy it, please help spread the word! Thank you so much!
